title: astragalus atropilosulus subsp. bequaertii
intro: Astragalus atropilosulus subsp. bequaertii, commonly known as the Bequaert's milkvetch, is a plant species in the legume family. It is used in traditional medicine, primarily in the Philippines and China, for its various health benefits. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may provide therapeutic actions such as reducing fever, relieving pain, and treating infections. The bioactive constituents of Astragalus atropilosulus subsp. bequaertii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
